title: spatialspill: calibrated estimation of cell-autonomous and spillover effects in spatial CRISPR screens
description: Estimands, estimators (stratified permutation, regression adjustment with spatial basis, augmented IPW, GNN counterfactuals), a ground-truth simulator, an artifact detector and loaders for five spatial CRISPR screen datasets, with pre-registered real-data analyses and a lab notebook. See README.md, STATUS.md and CRITIQUE.md for what was and was not achieved.
